line: This is Google Sheets, an app where you type numbers into small boxes.
You can also type an instruction, like add up these boxes for me, and it does the math.
Type that instruction in wrong, even one small typo, and the math just breaks.
Gemini, Google's AI built right into this app, already spotted the mistake. Before you did.
One button. Click Fix, and it checks every box in the whole sheet, not just this one.
And tells you why: you forgot to close the instruction. Now every number actually gets counted.
That's not the only thing it can do.
You can also type a question straight into any box, using the word AI, and Gemini gives a reply right there.
No new app, no new tab. The reply just shows up in the box.
The fix was never a plugin away. It was already inside the app you open every day.
The setup's in the link in bio.
Follow for the setup that actually works.
